author: GoPro
description:
Drop into one of the most iconic lines in big mountain skiing and snowboarding for the latest edition of Kings & Queens of Corbet’s—where style, creativity, and progression collide in the legendary Corbet’s Couloir at @jacksonhole Mountain Resort. With a stacked field of skiers and snowboarders featuring Olympians, X Games medalists, and Freeride World Tour athletes, riders pushed the limits with massive airs, technical tricks, and fearless lines down one of the most famous couloirs in North America.

After a day of heavy hits and creative runs, Tristen Lilly and Piper Kunst claimed the overall crowns as the 2026 King and Queen of Corbet’s, delivering standout performances that set the tone for the event and raised the bar once again for progression in the couloir.

Relive the biggest sends, most creative lines, and unforgettable moments from this year’s competition as the riders put it all on the line in Corbet’s.

For more ski + snowboard content, head to @GoProSnow ❄️
